title: Common Guarantee Gives The Value
body_html:
Common Guarantee Gives The Value

If player 1 and player 2 both guarantee the same number $w$, then $w$ is the unique value of the game, and the strategies witnessing the two guarantees are optimal.
proof_html: The two guarantees and weak duality give the chain $$ w \le \underline v \le \overline v \le w. $$ Thus $\underline v=\overline v=w$, and the witnessing strategies attain the value. $\square$
